visit_note.text:
Date of visit: 2026-02-10
Patient: 48-year-old woman, established patient.
Chief complaint: low back pain radiating to the leg
History: low back pain for 8 weeks, radiating below the knee. Naproxen and a home exercise programme for 7 weeks without improvement.
Examination: straight-leg raise positive; ankle reflex reduced on the affected side.
Assessment: lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
Signed: treating clinician. 2026-02-10.
